claims.quote: The gripping member 30 is a generally thin and plane element of generally U-shaped outline extending from the body of the clamp 10 and possessing a suction cavity 35 in an inside face, i.e. a face that faces towards the

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum-based wafer separation apparatus with a handle and suction gripping members, addressing some core features of the subject invention, but lacks details on exhaust air routing, sound damping, and specific housing configurations.
